mapper.select: SELECT a.cinema_id, c.cinema_name, a.admin_password FROM admins a JOIN cinemas c ON c.cinema_id = a.cinema_id WHERE a.admin_code = #{code}
SELECT room_id, room_name, floor, is_active AS active FROM rooms WHERE cinema_id = #{cinemaId} ORDER BY floor, room_id
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE bookings IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT u.login_id, u.phone_number, COUNT(bs.booked_seat_id) AS seat_count, STRING_AGG( '회차 ' || s.screening_id::text || ': ' || TRIM(st.row_name) || '열 ' || st.col_num::text || '번', ', ' ORDER BY s.screening_id, st.row_name, st.col_num ) AS seat_locations FROM bookings b JOIN screenings s ON s.screening_id = b.screening_id JOIN rooms r ON r.room_id = s.room_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN booked_seats bs ON bs.booking_id = b.booking_id AND bs.screening_id = s.screening_id LEFT JOIN seats st ON st.seat_id = bs.seat_id AND st.room_id = r.room_id WHERE r.cinema_id = #{cinemaId} AND r.room_id = #{roomId} AND b.booking_status = 'DONE' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.login_id, u.phone_number ORDER BY u.login_id
